The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-my-unfiltered-take-2|payment]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments for digital products leverage blockchain technology to facilitate transactions directly between buyers and sellers. This method bypasses the need for traditional payment processors, eliminating hefty fees such as Gumroad's 10% per sale. With NOWPayments, creators can accept crypto payments with only a 0.5% transaction fee. This shift not only reduces costs but also enhances control over the payment process, ensuring creators retain more revenue for their hard work.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture utilizes Solana's blockchain for fast and low-cost transactions. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is confirmed on-chain, triggering an automatic webhook that delivers the digital product instantly. This process is streamlined through tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, allowing creators to build an automated delivery system without needing extensive technical skills. The combination of these technologies creates a robust and efficient sales funnel.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Eliminate high platform fees with Solana payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this system include a digital storefront hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic executed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and order storage managed via Supabase or Google Sheets. These elements work in unison to create a seamless experience for both sellers and buyers, ensuring that digital products are delivered automatically upon payment confirmation without manual intervention.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start leveraging Solana payments for your digital products, first, select a hosting platform like GitHub Pages to set up your storefront. Next, implement Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, ensuring to integrate NOWPayments for transaction handling. Load your digital products into a storage solution like Supabase, and configure automatic delivery scripts to ensure customers receive their purchases instantly. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at our store.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automate delivery for all your digital products effortlessly.

For those looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is essential. This kit offers everything you need to build and deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack, allowing you to accept payments through NOWPayments and benefit from low transaction costs. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept cryptocurrency payments for my digital downloads?
You can accept cryptocurrency payments by integrating NOWPayments into your digital storefront. This service allows you to process transactions securely and efficiently while keeping fees low.
What tools do I need to set up my digital product store?
You need a hosting platform like GitHub Pages, backend processing tools like Cloudflare Workers, a payment processor like NOWPayments, and a storage solution such as Supabase to manage your orders.
Is it possible to automate product delivery after payment?
Yes, using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can create automated systems that deliver digital products immediately after payment confirmation.
What are the benefits of using Solana for payments?
Solana offers fast transaction speeds and low fees, making it ideal for digital product sales. This ensures that you retain more of your revenue compared to traditional platforms.
Can I sell multiple types of digital products with this setup?
Absolutely. This infrastructure supports the sale of ebooks, templates, courses, software, and other digital products, providing flexibility to creators.
Own your entire sales process without reliance on traditional payment systems.
